WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period = 4 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT st.store_id FROM dim_store st
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
    AND st.close_date IS NULL
    AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date < DATE '2025-07-28')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c, per p WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= p.e AND c.closure_end_date >= p.s)
),
sales AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, st.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) AS s_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = f.store_key JOIN per p ON f.sale_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
  WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM eligible) GROUP BY ALL
),
rets AS (
  SELECT p.fiscal_year, st.store_id, sum(r.refund_net) AS r_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = r.store_key JOIN per p ON r.return_date BETWEEN p.s AND p.e
  WHERE st.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM eligible) GROUP BY ALL
),
net AS (
  SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.store_id, s.s_net - coalesce(r.r_net, 0) AS net_sales FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets r USING (fiscal_year, store_id)
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period,
  count(DISTINCT store_id) AS lfl_stores,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END),2) AS py_net, round(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END),2) AS cy_net,
  round(100*(sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net_sales END)/sum(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net_sales END)-1),2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM net
